description: Papers that used CatBench in their published research. Add new entries to the top.

publications.title: Towards Out-of-Distribution Uncertainty Quantification for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials via Pre-Training
publications.authors: S. P. Schmid, T. Setzer, M. Scheurer (Merck KGaA)
publications.image_credit: Figure 1 from Schmid et al., arXiv:2610.41801, CC BY 4.0
publications.used: Ran all seven CatBench adsorption datasets with MACE-MP-0 and MACE-MPA-0 following the CatBench workflow, used its anomaly classifier to select normal adsorption energies, and fine-tuned pre-trained uncertainty models on CatBench structures.

publications.title: Graph-based machine learning model for adsorption energy prediction of CO2 hydrogenation intermediates on metal oxide catalysts
publications.authors: M. H. Risansyauqi, J. C. Villa-Arpi, H. Prats, A. Comas-Vives
publications.used: Used the CatBench D3(BJ) implementation and relaxation anomaly classifier, extending it with unconverged, desorption and cell-crossing categories.
